summary: Finished the Aura menswear store as a React app with Vite. It follows the same shopping structure as the reference site — header, hero, categories, arrivals, collections, occasions, pairs, journal, bag, and checkout — with the brand name Aura throughout. Verified size selection, add to bag, and a completed checkout order in the browser. The dev server is running at http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
current_status: Aura Clothing React storefront is runnable locally. Catalog, cart, wishlist, compare, stores, journal, and checkout are in place. Next step is any visual pass the user wants once they open the dev server rather than the raw index.html file.
